answer: Proof-of-stake protocols defend agent economies by mandating capital bonds, effectively anchoring digital assets to physical cost. An attacker attempting to simulate a sprawling wharf of malicious identities faces prohibitive costs; they must secure a massive ivory treasury to bypass stake-weighted voting. Like drilling through stubborn shale to access deep reserves, the sybil-resistant network forces attackers to exhaust finite economic resources rather than exploiting zero-marginal-cost identity creation.
